mapper.sql: id, member_id, version_no, changed_fields, avatar_ref, avatar_media_hash, create_time
mapper.insert: insert into ums_member_profile_version (member_id, version_no, changed_fields, avatar_ref, avatar_media_hash, create_time) select #{memberId}, coalesce(max(v.version_no), 0) + 1, #{changedFields}, #{avatarRef}, #{avatarMediaHash}, now() from ums_member_profile_version v where v.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: select from ums_member_profile_version where member_id = #{memberId} order by version_no desc limit 1
select from ums_member_profile_version where member_id = #{memberId} and avatar_ref is not null order by version_no desc limit 1
